messages:
Sam K: Heads-up — we had a small spike of fncall fallbacks hitting the degen route in eu-west at ~09:12 UTC. Not sure if it's schema noise or a model decode issue.
Maya R: On it — saw a bump in fncall_fallback_rate on the dashboard. Jumping into logs.
Alex P: Any sample payloads? that helps narrow whether it's input shape vs tool output shape.
Sam K: Pasting the snippet that failed validation (sanitized):
```json
{"user_id":"usr_123","intent":"get_invoice","tool_output":[{"line":1,"text":"..."}]}
```
Sam K: The validator expected `tool_output` to be an object with `items` key, not an array. So parse error -> strict gate -> fallback routing.
Taylor L: Ugh. This is the array vs object union again. customer sdk often produces both. We currently treat it as a hard reject unless soft-validate flag is on.
Maya R: ops-bot shows 47 fallbacks in 10m. sampling shows 3% of requests but concentrated to one customer + a few random anonymous sessions.
ops-bot: Alert: fncall_fallback_rate > 5% (eu-west) — triggered @eng-platform, @oncall. https://console/redwood/alerts/789
Jordan C: Can we increase sampling for failed validations so we get full payloads? right now sampling is 1/100.
Alex P: I'd add a temporary sampling bump for requests that hit the strict gate + the degen route for next 2 hours. Also tag those traces with route=degen-gate for billing attribution.
Maya R: Agree. Also we should differentiate strict-reject (hard) vs coercion-fixable in telemetry. Right now both count as a fallback.
Sam K: Proposed short term: 1) bump sample to 1/10 for strict rejects in eu-west for 2h; 2) surface top-5 example payloads per route in Console; 3) add histogram metric fncall_validation_type{hard,soft,coercion} so we can split.
Taylor L: For Console UX — top-5 payloads need scrubbed PII. We should reuse the existing payload-redactor flow. Also show the validator diff (expected vs seen).
Jordan C: Who owns the route->billing label? we need to ensure fallbacks aren't double-billed as full fncall cost. Ops needs that for chargeback.
Maya R: Ops/infra can add route tag, but product needs to confirm billing rule: fallback => discounted unit_rate? we discussed previously but not finalized.
Alex P: Longer term: add per-customer strictness toggle (customer overrides) and a canary for changing gate from hard->soft for a subset. That will reduce noisy fallbacks.
Sam K: Can we implement an emergency rollout: soft-validate = true for the affected customer id until they fix payloads? low-risk toggle.
Taylor L: I can wire a per-account flag in 30m as a temporary fix. Will patch the routing policy to not route to degen if soft-validate true.
Maya R: I'll schedule the sampling bump and add an entry in the incident board. tagging @oncall for visibility. :white_check_mark:
Alex P: Also added a quick dashboard panel request: show recent schema mismatch examples and the most common mismatched field names.
Sam K: Thanks. Post-mortem action items: update docs for tool_output union types, add example mapping in SDK, and add telemetry split.
Taylor L: On it. Will update PR link: https://git/redwood/pulls/4242
Maya R: Closing loop: after the bump and soft-validate flip for that customer, fallback rate dropped to ~0.4% within 15m. Monitoring for 1h.
Sam K: Nice. Follow-up: let's decide billing semantics by EOD.
Jordan C: +1 — will coordinate with finance.
